description: Source code for BackendIO and InFlightBackendIO classes managing disk cache backend operations, including asynchronous I/O handling, operation execution, and callback management within the disk cache subsystem.

classes.name: BackendIO
classes.description: Handles individual backend I/O operations, including initialization, opening, creating, reading, writing, and other cache management tasks, with asynchronous callback support.

classes.name: InFlightBackendIO
classes.description: Manages multiple concurrent backend I/O operations, queues tasks, and handles their execution and completion callbacks within a dedicated background thread context.

methods.name: LeakEntryImpl
methods.description: Leakes a strong reference to an EntryImpl object, returning a raw pointer while managing reference counts.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteOperation
methods.description: Determines whether to execute an entry-specific or backend-specific operation and dispatches accordingly.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteBackendOperation
methods.description: Executes backend-level operations such as open, create, doom, and enumeration, updating result status.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteEntryOperation
methods.description: Performs specific entry I/O operations like read, write, sparse read/write, and range queries.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::Init
methods.description: Initializes a backend operation and posts it to the background thread.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Queues an open or create entry operation.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::ReadData
methods.description: Queues a read data operation for an entry.
